_comment: Drives test/klippy/multi_mcu_avr.test under the EMULATOR multi-bridge fan-out. tick_mode is required so the three bridges advance in lockstep with klippy's reactor; otherwise their independent free-run clocks drift and klippy's clock-sync flags one of them. auto_trsync_trigger_ticks fires each tower's endstop after 100 step edges so G28 completes -- the fixture pusher knows to route the step_trigger commands to the bridge that owns each stepper's pins (X/Y on main mcu, Z on zboard). analog_in_default keeps the auxboard's thermistor ADC reads (PK5 extruder, PK6 bed) in-range so the heater_min_temp/max_temp checks don't trip during startup; the same default goes to all three bridges since the unused ADC pins on mcu/zboard don't matter.
